item.title: New Ron DeSantis gallium statue unveiled in Tallahassee is melting in the sun – Uncommon New York reveals 'DENIAL' – a life-size statue of Florida Governor Ron DeSantis with supporters and onlookers in attendance. Hours later, it began to melt.
item.description:
I like how he morphs into Ron DeSkeletor.
DENIAL, a new installation from 350actionus, mssngpeces & Uncommon, is sculpted from gallium, a metal that melts below Tallahassee's average summer highs. It marks the moment Florida erased "climate change" from state law while spending more than $1 billion responding to floods, storms & heat. Once the applause fades, we're the ones left with the consequences.

item.title: GovBrief Today #626
item.description: Emiliano Andrade-Covarrubias had his medicine with him when he was detained, but his daughter says the staff at his ICE jail wouldn’t give it to him. The Dallas painter was jailed in June. Guards found him dead in his Laredo cell Saturday morning. His family learned of his death from the county medical examiner, because nobody from ICE called them. Emiliano told his family his chest felt tight and he was having trouble breathing. He said the medical staff “would just ignore him.” ICE’s own detention rules say the people it holds shall receive continuity of care. On Monday his daughter, an American citizen, goes to the jail to collect his personal effects. I’ve emailed 9,572 stories over 626 straight nights, free and without ads. The algorithm can’t show them all to you. Add your email address at govbrief.today and I will. item.description: PJM runs the power grid for 13 states and Washington, DC, about 65 million people.
